description:
On the credits page a bunch of space agencies show up under Wikimedia Commons instead of where they belong.

## Reporter answers (follow-up)

Q: CFHT (1 entry, smart-1/05.jpg): 'esa' (SMART-1 is an ESA mission), 'csa' (Canada is a CFHT stakeholder), or new 'cfht' section?
A: I don't know.

Q: EHT (1 entry, science/black-holes-m87.jpg): new 'eht' section or stay under 'wikimedia-commons'?
A: I don't know.

Q: Multi-agency (42 entries, ISS/Hubble/JWST etc.): resolved per-entry to primary agency, or accepted as 'wikimedia-commons'?
A: I don't know.

Q: publisher (31 entries, fair-use book/film covers): stay under 'wikimedia-commons', or new 'publisher' section?
A: I don't know.

Q: public-domain (6 entries, historical PD images): stay under 'wikimedia-commons', or new 'public-domain' section?
A: I don't know.

Q: Unknown (8 entries): resolved to entity's catalog agency, or 'wikimedia-commons' fallback?
A: I don't know.

Q: agency original via Wikimedia Commons mirror (10 entries): resolved to entity's source agency, or 'wikimedia-commons'?
A: I don't know.

Q: Individual photographers (Björn Jónsson, Bubba73, Don Senda): which section each?
A: I don't know.

## Reporter answers (follow-up)

Q: Routing policy for SpaceIL (11 entries): should these get a new source-logos entry (like SpaceX, Blue Origin, ispace, Intuitive Machines) or map to an existing section?
A: SpaceIL gets its own section → spaceil.

Q: Routing policy for CFHT (1 entry): should this route to ESA (SMART-1 is an ESA mission), CSA (Canada is a CFHT stakeholder), or a new 'cfht' section?
A: I don't know.

Q: Routing policy for EHT (1 entry): new 'eht' source-logos entry or stay under Wikimedia Commons?
A: I don't know.

Q: Routing policy for Multi-agency (42 entries): resolve per-entry to primary agency, or accept as Wikimedia Commons?
A: The primary-credit rule: the first agency token (split on " / ") decides the section.

Q: Routing policy for publisher (31 entries, fair-use book/film covers): new 'publisher' section or stay under Wikimedia Commons?
A: I don't know.

Q: Routing policy for public-domain (6 entries): new 'public-domain' section or stay under Wikimedia Commons?
A: I don't know.

Q: Routing policy for Unknown (8 entries): resolve to entity's catalog agency, or keep as Wikimedia Commons fallback?
A: I don't know.

Q: Routing policy for 'agency original via Wikimedia Commons mirror' (7 entries without a leading agency prefix): accept the path-based resolution (gaia→ESA, sbirs-heo→USSF, tiangong-1→CNSA, vostok→Roscosmos, apollo8→NASA, dart→NASA, luna21→Roscosmos) or fix the provenance data at build time?
A: I don't know.
